verdict.rationale: Appwrite's database docs mention 'managed APIs with permissions and realtime' (appwrite-docs-23), implying some access-control layer, but the evidence pack contains no detailed documentation of row/document-level permission rules, policy syntax, or examples akin to Firebase/Supabase security rules. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on permission scopes (read/write per role/user), examples of row-level rules, and any independent verification that these permissions enforce per-user data isolation.
